programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa's First Word: The family try to get Maggie to say her first word. But Homer's glad that she hasn't spoken yet, because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him.

programme.title: Hollyoaks

programme.title: America's Next Top Model

programme.title: New: Married at First Sight UK
programme.desc: Brand new series: It's commitment crunch time as the vow renewals continue. One emotional groom questions whether he's enough, and a couple decide whether long-distance can work.

programme.title: New: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Brand new series: Mel Giedroyc hosts the erotic showbiz book club. In a fictional racy rendezvous acted out by naughty puppets, Kerry Katona's driven wild by a saucy secret admirer. (Ep3/6)

programme.title: New: No Strings Attached

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Brides Against Bridesmaids. Two brides let their bridesmaids choose their own dresses. Lori has to take control to prevent these ladies going down the aisle looking crazy. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress Lancashire
programme.desc: Make Room For The Groom. Hannah is no longer sure she wants the huge princess gown she dreamed of as a child. And, Lisa turns up to the boutique with her fiancé! S2, Ep19

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: I Wanna Be Naked. The consultants have a client who wants to show all of her body on her wedding day. Plus, Randy is pushed for time when a bride has only a month until her big day! S18, Ep2

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: The Facilitators. Tamika is on the hunt for the perfect dress, but can she stay within her budget? Plus, Ashley finds the perfect princess dress, but can she afford it? S7, Ep10

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Never Settle. Three more brides search for the perfect dress including Elona who has overcome tremendous obstacles to be at the salon and Courtney who takes her mum for help. S7, Ep11

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Atlanta
programme.desc: When the Leading Man Takes a Stand. To Kiara, the only opinion that matters is her grandfathers. But when she likes a dress over budget, she may risk leaving the salon empty handed. S8, Ep12

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Atlanta
programme.desc: Mother May I? Jibrell wants to look like a princess, but her mother turns her dress dreams into a nightmare. Plus, Kassie struggles to find a gown without her late mother. S8, Ep13

programme.title: Forensic Detectives
programme.desc: Camera Clues. Forensic photographers are often first at the scene of a crime, capturing vital clues on film; but what can these pictures reveal? S1, Ep5

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Four Weddings And A Funeral. After four marriages, 36-year-old Carol Grannon returned to school and got a lucrative job. But, one of her men ended her life as this new chapter began. S3, Ep5

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Trail Of Terror. When two young women are murdered on the same scenic bike trail just months apart, police are baffled by the similarities of their deaths. S13, Ep25

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Rhonda's Gone. When Rhonda Daugherty vanishes, detectives turn to the public for information. A tip leads to surveillance footage from a hotel that uncovers a journey of deceit. S4, Ep14

programme.title: Faking It
programme.desc: Chris Parker. Experts analyse a man's deception following the Manchester Arena terror attack. Police tapes expose a man who murdered his wife and hid her body in the freezer. S3, Ep2

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: I Love My Wife. Ann Metz lives for her family. Her husband Marshall despises Ann giving her time to anyone but him, and he will do anything to keep hold of her. S10, Ep2

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: I Saw Dad Kill Mom. Five-year-old Audrey witnesses her mother, Diane, brutally stabbed to death. To Audrey's horror, her mother's murderer is somebody very close to home. S10, Ep3

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: The Last Summer. When 15-year-old Kayla Berg isn't home after a night out, her loved ones think she's staying with friends. After six days, her last known location raises suspicion. S8, Ep5

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories
programme.desc: Double Tragedy And Grace Banks. Judge Rinder examines the murder case of a girl whose younger sister was also dying of terminal cancer. Then, he looks into a gang of puppy traders. S3, Ep3

programme.title: Murder On CCTV
programme.desc: Rideshare Nightmare. In 2019, after a night out with friends, student Samantha Josephson climbs into a car she mistakes for her rideshare, never to be seen alive again. S8, Ep9

programme.title: New: American Monster
programme.desc: Weight Control. Ashley's new confidence enrages estranged husband Terry, who stalks her to a secluded lot, ready to reclaim control in the deadliest way. S11, Ep7

programme.title: The Killer In My Family
programme.desc: Lisa Montgomery. Relatives of Lisa Montgomery speak out about how they believe her mental health and history of serious sexual abuse led to her strangling a pregnant woman. S3, Ep6

programme.title: And Then There Were None (1974)

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Faces in the Dark
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by David Eady. Starring John Gregson, Mai Zetterling & John Ireland. Richard, a factory owner, becomes blind during an experiment on the very day his wife wants a divorce.

programme.title: Pot O' Gold
programme.desc: 1941. Musical starring James Stewart, Paulette Goddard and Horace Heidt. Jimmy, the owner of a failed music shop, goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory.

programme.title: What a Whopper
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. What a Whopper is a comedy from former documentarist Gilbert Gunn. Adam Faith stars in this tale about a struggling writer who fakes photographs of the Loch Ness monster.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Liars. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Ringo poses as a killer in order to learn which of the four gang members waiting to be hanged was really innocent of killing two bank tellers.

programme.title: Look At Life So They all Hover Now
programme.desc: 1962. Currently, trucks, barrows and even stretchers are now using hover power. This film further explores hovercraft and how it has developed since its introduction in 1959.

programme.title: Passport To Treason
programme.desc: 1956. Crime Drama. Directed by Robert S. Baker. Stars Rod Cameron and Lois Maxwell. Clifford, an American private eye, stationed in London for the sake of a murdered friend, takes over a case.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the second half of November.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Sheep Shearing/Sea Bream. 1986. In the high Dorset downs, the sheep shearing team has arrived. Jack goes to watch before taking a trawler in pursuit of another annual visitor, the sea bream.

programme.title: Operation Diplomat
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Directed by John Guillermin. Stars Guy Rolfe, Lisa Daniely, Patricia Dainton. A surgeon is forced to operate on an injured man by a gang of smugglers.

programme.title: AD Eldorado Ice Cream Production Line
programme.desc: 1937. A look behind the scenes in the Eldorado Ice Cream Factory.

programme.title: Churchill's Secret Army
programme.desc: In the Beginning. 2003. Peter Williams tells the untold story of the British Resistance movement, set up around the coast by Winston Churchill, as Britain stood alone against Nazi Germany in 1940.

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
